title: UFO said to hover over channeling sessions

tellings.quote: right now, there's a a UFO that's sort of hovering over this session and and some claim to have witnessed that.

plain: In the 1970s, during channeling sessions, where people spoke messages said to come from non-human beings, at the lab of a researcher named Puharich, the messages reportedly announced that a UFO was hovering over the session right then, and some claim to have seen it. An unnamed researcher tells this on an episode about a CIA scientist who says he contacted an alien council, passing on what was said by the "space kids," the young people involved. If true, it would tie the spoken messages to something physical in the sky.
